item.title: github: Customize the reasoning level for Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Copilot cloud agent now lets you set the reasoning level for supported models when delegating a task. This gives you control over how much reasoning the agent uses for a request.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed settings in the GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent now support enterprise managed settings, letting organizations apply the same centrally managed Copilot policies across the enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Mobile: Fix failing Actions checks with Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Mobile now lets you ask Copilot coding agent to investigate and fix failing GitHub Actions checks on a pull request directly from the mobile app. The feature starts from a failed check and uses Copilot cloud agent to work on the issue.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Gemini models in Copilot CLI, cloud agent, and the Copilot app
item.description:
GitHub added Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) and Gemini 3.5 Flash to more Copilot surfaces. The models are now available in Copilot CLI, Copilot cloud agent, and the GitHub Copilot app.

  • Source: GitHub
